title: Send an approved change back to draft for re-scoping
description: Send an approved change back to draft for re-scoping
acceptance_criteria: When a change's scope turns out wrong after approval, I can send it back to be re-scoped instead of deleting it by hand.
Sending it back needs a named person and a reason, and both stay in the change's history.
Sending it back cancels its approval, so the new scope needs a fresh one.
Nothing already recorded about the change is lost.

answers.constraints: CHANGE-6.c: changing scope costs a fresh approval, so a send-back cancels every earlier approval. CHANGE-12.c: append-only, nothing recorded is removed. Accepted and archived changes keep using change reopen. Never weaken a gate. Leif chose 'Both A and B' on 2026-11-04; this change is option A only.
